adjudication.rationale: In app/models/embeddable_host.rb, `self.record_for_host(host)` is passed a full URL string in callers (e.g. `record_for_host(url)` in TopicEmbed.import and `host_allowed?(request.referer)`), then immediately does `uri = URI(host)` and reassigns `host = uri.host`. This works correctly, but the parameter name `host` is misleading and is shadowed by a different meaning (hostname), which hurts readability/maintainability. Renaming the parameter to `url` (or similar) would clarify intent.
